findings.source_issue: Replacing the ordinary successor step by the predecessor form requires a positive current index; zero has no predecessor in the natural numbers.
findings.minimal_treatment: Qualify this rephrasing to positive indices and disclose; no formula needs alteration.

findings.source_issue: The quoted empty-domain premise says P(0) for every l<0, while the general strong-induction antecedent is P(l) for every l<k. The former is also vacuously true, but it is not the antecedent being instantiated.
findings.minimal_treatment: State the instantiated antecedent with P(l) and disclose the index repair.
